scope: Independent read-only review; implementation is ongoing. Findings are not closed by this record.

findings.issue: Normal empty XYW fixture must not fail a positive visible-piece assertion; independently verify expected emptiness and stale mesh removal.
Cancel an owned gesture before switching screen/session and restore the captured original animator, not a mutable current slice.
A click on an already selected piece is weak evidence. Verify a real selection change, selected-cell frame vertices and known-triangle hit agreement.
Settings origin/center controls must be reachable without replacing approved 2D mini views or adding permanent controls.
Build and launch source checks must detect added paths as well as modified or missing files.
Timeout, identity failure or exceptional interruption must stop and wait for the exact child process launched, recording its exit. Successful interactive launches are separate.
Validate the successful Unity process command output/run/request/design arguments against the current build identity.
Validate phase names and resolved launch path containment within the run.
Use atomic Player identity output or bounded read retry to prevent existence-versus-write races.
Only exclude the distribution manifest at the build root, not same-named files in arbitrary subdirectories.
Update board-space help from misleading all-Y=0 wording to the displayed embedding plane Y=h and initial center P; document reachable center controls.
